title: Attune Creative #2 — Notice the Moment
objective: Show how noticing a subtle emotional shift can replace a damaging assumption with calm attention.
hook: A tiny ambiguous emotional change that could easily be misunderstood.
coreMessage: Pause and notice the moment before making an assumption about a partner.
audienceIntent: Help couples respond to ambiguous emotional moments with attentive curiosity.
creativeConcept: A restrained three-beat apartment story moves from uncertainty through a pause to connection.
visualStyle: Vertical cinematic realism with observational camera work and natural micro-expressions.

storyboard.purpose: Show the tiny ambiguous moment where someone could easily make the wrong assumption.
storyboard.subject: A couple in their early 30s sitting together on a sofa; concrete appearance details await operator input.
storyboard.action: The woman becomes quieter, turns slightly away and looks into the room; her partner notices and pauses before speaking.
storyboard.environment: One warm lived-in apartment living room in the evening with a sofa and practical lamps; concrete layout awaits operator input.
storyboard.emotionalIntent: Subtle ambiguity and attentive concern without theatrical sadness, argument, or melodrama.
storyboard.framing: Vertical cinematic medium-wide at eye level.
storyboard.camera: Restrained observational camera with very subtle natural movement.
storyboard.lensComposition: Natural perspective holding both partners and their spatial relationship in one coherent frame.
storyboard.lighting: Warm practical apartment lamps, believable skin tones, and soft evening contrast.
storyboard.continuity: Establish the same couple, sofa positions, wardrobe, room layout, lamps, and props for all shots.

storyboard.purpose: Visually demonstrate calm attention instead of assumption.
storyboard.subject: The same couple from shot one, with the exact approved appearance and wardrobe still awaiting operator input.
storyboard.action: Instead of reacting, the partner pauses, softens his posture, turns toward her, gently reaches for her hand, and she looks back.
storyboard.environment: The same sofa and apartment living room established in shot one, with unchanged practical lamps and props.
storyboard.emotionalIntent: Calm attention conveyed through natural micro-expressions, without an exaggerated smile.
storyboard.camera: Restrained observational camera with stable, nearly imperceptible movement.
storyboard.lensComposition: Natural close medium composition emphasizing the pause, softened posture, and hand gesture.
storyboard.lighting: The same warm practical lamp direction, believable skin tones, and soft evening contrast.
storyboard.continuity: Preserve exact identity, appearance, wardrobe, sofa positions, apartment layout, lamps, and props from shot one.
storyboard.voiceoverSegment: Before you assume, notice the moment.

storyboard.purpose: Resolve the emotional beat and land the product idea without an artificial stock-ad ending.
storyboard.subject: The same exact couple with approved appearance and wardrobe still awaiting operator input.
storyboard.action: They remain sitting close; tension softens and she gives a small authentic relaxed expression without a dramatic embrace.
storyboard.environment: The same unchanged apartment living room, sofa, practical lamps, and established props.
storyboard.emotionalIntent: Quiet relief and authentic connection, restrained and believable.
storyboard.framing: Vertical cinematic medium shot resolving into a slightly closer composition.
storyboard.camera: A restrained slow push-in with no dramatic flourish.
storyboard.lensComposition: Balanced two-person composition that keeps the couple grounded in the established room.
storyboard.lighting: The same warm practical apartment lighting and soft evening contrast.
